description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget extending TextView, used to output log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log messages with different priorities, handles exceptions, and supports chaining with other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays formatted log messages received via the LogNode interface, supporting log levels, exceptions, and chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message with a given priority, tag, message, and optional exception. Also forwards the log to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
